name: The Coat's Secret

start.dialog: [Mysterious whispering] The coat speaks... it says something was stolen. My lucky button. Fell off near the windmill. Find it... and I'll share what the shadows know about the Dominion.
start.objective: Search near the windmill for a lost coat button

progress.dialog: [Coat rustles ominously] The button calls... can you not hear it?
progress.objective: Continue searching around the windmill and surrounding area

complete.dialog: [The coat seems to sigh with relief] Found... yes. The coat is whole again. Here - Dominion patrol schedules. Stolen from a courier. Use this knowledge... wisely.

party_comments.kade: That coat is... talking? Or is he...?
party_comments.nix7: Unclear if subject or coat is sentient. Both possible.
party_comments.twist: I want a talking coat! Does it come in purple?

hidden_outcome: If you also find a matching button (from a different coat), Trenchcoat Black reveals he is actually two very small people sharing one coat
